title: The Epyx Collection: Handheld
summary: A collection of six classic Atari Lynx games, out now on Xbox, and on Nintendo Switch.
lede: A collection of six classic Atari Lynx games, now out on Xbox, packed with late 80s and early 90s nostalgia.
body: Developed by Imagine Software, these retro classics are packed with late 80s and early 90s nostalgia and are just as fun and challenging to play today as they were when they were first released. Each of them is available on Xbox for the first time.

features.title: Rewind
features.text: Rewind up to 5 seconds of live gameplay

features.title: Suspend points
features.text: Up to 5 suspend points per game

features.title: CRT and LCD filters
features.text: Play it the way you remember it

features.title: 3D box and cartridge
features.text: Interactive 3D modelled game box and cartridge

title: The Epyx Games Sports Collection
summary: Over 50 athletic and sporting events across eight of Epyx’s retro classics, including the best-seller California Games.
intro: In the 1980s, the gold-medal-winning name for sports games on the C64 was Epyx.

title: Epyx Rogue
summary: Explore the Dungeons of Doom in search of the Amulet of Yendor. Originally released in 1980.

title: Chip’s Challenge
summary: The 1989 classic returns with over 140 levels to put your mind (and your fingers) to the test.

title: Hidden Gems: Volume One
summary: Four classic Commodore 64 games: N.O.M.A.D., Gilligan’s Gold, Mutant Monty and Horace Goes Skiing.

title: The Monty Mole Collection
summary: Wanted! Monty Mole, Monty on the Run, Auf Wiedersehen Monty and Moley Christmas, plus bonus game Sam Stoat: Safebreaker.
